text:
alex: Quick heads-up — PR #9123 is ready for review but blocked on architecture sign-off. Linking RFC-231 which defines the new routing + fallback semantics: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/231

priya: thx alex. PR description includes perf numbers and canary plan. RFC link in top comment. pinging arch team for stamp. @marta @ryan

sam: quick Q: any SLA/latency impact we should call out? customers will ask.

alex: short summary — expected p99 increase ~3ms for routed model combos, but reduces tail by avoiding cold fallback. Added a perf table in PR. If we need to, can keep canary at 1% for longer.

marta: I’ll take a look tomorrow morning in office hours (9:30 PT). If you need faster, paste the canary config here so I can eyeball.

alex: thanks. pasted config below: 
```yaml
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration: 1h
  rollback_on:
    - error_rate > 0.05
    - p99_latency_increase > 0.1
routes:
  - name: fast-path
    model: gpt-lite-v1
  - name: fallback
    model: gpt-base-v1
```

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #9123 (build 789) :white_check_mark:

sam: ok looks sensible. @ryan could infra folks verify memory/kv-cache impact before we merge?

ryan: noted. I ran a quick capacity sim against the change — small extra KV cache per shard (~120MB) at peak. Ops is fine with it if canary stays <=10% and we have a rollback trigger.

priya: release note: this is blocking Friday's canary window. Need arch stamp by EOD Thursday to hit schedule.

marta: gave RFC-231 a skim — main questions covered. Left 3 inline comments on PR about explicit rollback threshold wording and a tiny doc link to the routing decision. Overall +1 pending that small doc tweak.

alex: updated PR: added explicit `rollback_on: p99_latency_increase > 0.08` and added link to routing decision doc.

ryan: infra +1 (checked resource matrix and canary constraints).

marta: arch stamp: :white_check_mark: per RFC-231. small nit addressed. You have arch approval to merge once CI stays green.

priya: adding final approval from product side, will monitor metrics during canary window.

alex: thanks everyone — will merge at 10:05 PT tomorrow (after low-traffic window) and start 1h 5% canary. I’ll post follow-up metrics in #eng-runtime.

sam: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: PR #9123 merged by alex at 2067040255 (deploy pipeline triggered).
